root_cause.text: Missing initialization of `struct io_waitid::info` in `io_waitid_prep` allows stale kernel data from a reused `io_kiocb` to be copied to userspace when the waitid operation completes without writing to `wo_info`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `memset(&iw->info, 0, sizeof(iw->info));` in `io_waitid_prep`. The CVE description explains that if the wait completes without a child event, the common wait code returns without writing `wo_info`, yet `io_waitid_finish()` still copies `iw->info` to userspace, exposing stale bytes.

intent_record.intent_summary: Zero-initialize the info field in io_waitid_prep to prevent uninitialized data from being used.
intent_record.what: Added a memset call to zero-initialize the iw->info field in the io_waitid_prep function.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the iw->info structure will now always start with all bytes set to zero, ensuring no stale or uninitialized data is used when processing the waitid request.
